evidence.snippet: Angela: He's just trying to push your buttons.

beats.summary: Andy argues on the phone with his Dad about staying calm and mentions the third person is 'poking the bear'.

evidence.snippet: Andy (in parking lot on cell phone): Don't tell me to calm down, Dad! Don't do that!

beats.summary: Angela questions Dwight's motives for challenging Andy, and Dwight claims he can get into Cornell while Andy cannot.

evidence.snippet: Angela: Why are you doing this to Andy?

beats.summary: Angela expresses that even if Dwight gets into Cornell, it won't make her leave Andy, but Dwight says it will make her respect Andy less.

evidence.snippet: Angela (looks at Dwight disgustedly and sighs): Even if you do somehow get in, that's not going to make me leave Andy.
Dwight: No, but it'll make you respect him less.
